scope: Offline local source extraction and family metadata integration for the fixed V77 fresh case set. No academic payload, permission, licence, publication, production or native evaluation changes.

methods.ncert_pdf_identity: Raw SHA-256 of exact local PDF bytes; referenced facts were matched against normalized page extraction or exact column-row text at recorded source offsets.
methods.cuet_syllabus_pdf_identity: Raw SHA-256 of exact CUET 2026 syllabus PDF bytes from the older source-candidate root. Physical-page-order text was extracted with PyPDF; cited excerpts were compared after lowercase alphanumeric normalization, with similarity 0.9914–0.9982 across five source records.
methods.authored_stimuli: Exact passage bytes are the identity and extraction; candidate passage text equals the source passage byte-for-byte.
methods.source_material: Imported factoryEvidence.sourceMaterial and validated every frozen ref for active state, extraction_checked, reuse_permitted, identity presence, version, locator text hash and support hash.
methods.metadata_boundary: All source text, refs, versions, URLs, permissions and reuse scope preserved. Added extraction metadata for 26 used sources, corrected authored identity hashes to exact text bytes, and added state=active for 18 referenced families without changing IDs, versions or memberships.
